summary: M4 Writer Intelligence Dashboard — 5 intelligence panels surfacing existing backend data through right-panel UI
approach: 3-wave execution: Wave 1 builds shared foundation (panel infrastructure, shared components, CSS tokens, i18n keys), Wave 2 implements 5 panels in parallel, Wave 3 integrates animations, accessibility, and tests. All panels follow Variant A — Observatory design direction with CSS-only layouts (no external libs).

waves.label: Foundation
waves.description: Extend panel infrastructure, create shared components, add CSS tokens and i18n keys

waves.label: Panel Implementation
waves.description: Implement 5 intelligence panels in parallel using shared components from Wave 1

waves.label: Polish & Tests
waves.description: Animation tokens integration, accessibility pass, and panel tests

backend_apis.evaluation: evaluateWithModules(), evaluateContent(), runConsistencyCheck(), getImprovementSuggestions() from evaluation.ts

data_flow.panel_infrastructure: RightPanelType union → AppRightPanels lazy loading → useAppPanelOrchestration → Sidebar trigger buttons

design_decisions: CSS-only implementation: no external visualization library
Right-panel placement: 400px width, following existing AppRightPanels.tsx pattern
Standalone panels: Character Relationships and Evaluation Drill-Down are new right panels (not tabs)
Accordion: single-expand for Evaluation Drill-Down, multi-expand for Foreshadowing Tracker
No i18n framework: follow existing useI18n + translations.ts pattern
